name: Corona Lorenzo Manuel Berho
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman of the Board, Corporación Inmobiliaria Vesta (Vesta Real Estate Corp., BMV/NYSE: VTMX)
profile: Lorenzo Berho Corona co-founded Vesta in 1998, a Mexican developer and owner of industrial parks and build-to-suit logistics facilities. He chairs the board while his son Lorenzo Dominique Berho Carranza is CEO (since 2018). Vesta listed on the NYSE in 2023 and is riding nearshoring demand in Mexico.
interesting_fact: Vesta debuted on the New York Stock Exchange in 2023 and accelerated a US$1.1bn development pipeline to finish two years early because of nearshoring demand.
notes: Do not confuse with son Lorenzo Berho Carranza (Vesta CEO). Aggregator profiles say he led the Mexican industrial parks association AMPIP (2007-09) and chaired YPO's real estate network, but I did not verify these from primary sources. Best route: Vesta IR.

name: Erez Shachar
current_role: Co-founder & Managing Partner, Qumra Capital (Tel Aviv); director of Taboola, Riskified and Talkspace
profile: Israeli venture investor who co-founded growth-stage fund Qumra Capital (c. 2013) after running Evergreen Venture Partners as managing partner from 2004. He was earlier CEO of NUR Macroprinters. His wealth is tied to stakes and board seats in Israeli tech names such as Taboola, Fiverr, Riskified and Talkspace.
interesting_fact: He has sat on Riskified's board since July 2015, years before its 2021 NYSE IPO, and has been on the boards of several Israeli tech IPOs incl. Taboola, Fiverr and Talkspace.
deep_cut_fact: Before becoming a VC he was CEO and President of NUR Macroprinters, an Israeli maker of wide-format digital printing presses.
notes: Low public profile; best route is Qumra Capital's general inbox. Deep-cut source is a secondary aggregator (theorg) - verify before citing.

name: Neetu Menda
current_role: Director, RMZ Corp Holdings Pvt Ltd and RMZ Realtors Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru)
profile: Neetu (Raj) Menda is a member of the Menda family behind RMZ Corp, the Bengaluru commercial real-estate and infrastructure group founded in 2002 by Arjun Menda and sons Raj and Manoj Menda. Corporate registry data lists her as a director of RMZ group holding entities; she has no public executive role.
interesting_fact: RMZ's governing Supervisory Board is made up entirely of Menda family members (Raj, Manoj, Sidharth, Mihir and Kunal Menda).
notes: Very private; virtually no public profile. Registry names her 'Neetu Raj Menda' (likely Raj Menda's family) - relationship not confirmed. Best route is via RMZ corporate (contact@rmz.com).

name: Sheng Guofu
current_role: Chairman and controlling shareholder, Hongda High-Tech Holding Co. (宏达高科, SZSE: 002144), formerly Zhejiang Hongda Warp Knitting, Haining
profile: Shen/Sheng Guofu (沈国甫) has run the Haining Xucun warp-knitting factory since 1985, converted it into Zhejiang Hongda Warp Knitting in 1997 and has chaired the listed successor, Hongda High-Tech, since 2001. The company remains a leading warp-knit fabric maker and has added a medical-device business.
interesting_fact: He has led the same business for 40 years - from factory director of the Xucun warp-knitting plant in 1985 to chairman of the listed company - and still chaired its board meetings in 2026.
deep_cut_fact: He served as president of the Zhejiang Warp Knitting Industry Association (浙江省经编行业协会).
notes: Name in company filings is 沈国甫 (Shen Guofu). mqq@ is the board secretary (Ma Qiangqiang) per 2026 filing. Chinese-language outreach advised. Deep-cut source is the 2020 SZSE filing with his resume - verify page.

name: Prahlad Rai Agarwal
current_role: Chairman (Executive Chairman & Whole-time Director), Rupa & Company Ltd, Kolkata
profile: Prahlad Rai Agarwala (b. 1938, Shekhawati) co-founded the Rupa knitwear brand in 1968 with brothers Ghanshyam Prasad and Kunj Bihari Agarwal; Rupa grew into one of India's largest innerwear and hosiery makers and exporters. He has chaired Rupa & Company since 1985; the family promoter group owns about 74%.
interesting_fact: He received the Padma Shri in 2022 for trade and industry, cited as a 'flag bearer of Make in India'.
deep_cut_fact: His first venture, Binod Hosiery, set up in 1962, failed before he co-founded Rupa six years later; he also trained in law (LLB, University of Calcutta) and is Honorary Consul of Colombia in Kolkata.
notes: Aged 88; missed the 41st AGM (Kunj Bihari Agarwal presided). Best route is company secretary / IR in Kolkata.
